repository_edit_scope: Read only; outputs only in the coordinator-owned closure directory

sources.title: New Relativistic Theory for Modified Newtonian Dynamics
sources.supports: Linear fluid pressure depends on extra vector data; scalar mode spectrum has zero-frequency and propagating branches; nonlinear formation is an open problem in this paper.
sources.limits: No new nonlinear conclusion; a frequency is not a damping rate.

sources.title: Aether scalar tensor theory: Hamiltonian Formalism
sources.authors: Marianthi Bataki, Constantinos Skordis and Tom Zlosnik
sources.inspected: Primary HTML, together with the prior independently reviewed model specification
sources.supports: Canonical formulation and constraints of the reference AeST action; six physical degrees of freedom.
sources.limits: This pass did not implement the canonical map or extend it to higher derivatives.

sources.title: Caustic free completion of pressureless perfect fluid and k-essence
sources.supports: A canonical complex-field classical completion can remove a pressureless caustic under specific initial-data assumptions; the nonrelativistic limit relates to the Schrodinger equation.
sources.limits: Not a quantum UV completion or AeST completion. Does not establish a thermal fluid.

sources.title: On the Schrodinger-Poisson--Vlasov-Poisson correspondence
sources.authors: Philip Mocz, Lachlan Lancaster, Anastasia Fialkov, Fernando Becerra and Pierre-Henri Chavanis
sources.inspected: Abstract, introduction, equations 1-7 and discussion of smoothing and shell crossing
sources.supports: Field descriptions can reproduce collisionless multistream phenomena; unsmoothed density interference and smoothed moments need distinction.
sources.limits: Published self-gravitating correspondence is not an AeST result. Our control is free Schrodinger without self-gravity.

sources.title: Large-Scale Velocity Dispersion and the Cosmic Web
sources.inspected: Primary arXiv abstract and primary publication section 2 at https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stz1243
sources.supports: Anisotropic velocity dispersion after collapse and its dependence on collapse history are established results.
sources.limits: Cosmological collisionless simulations, not AeST. General novelty claim only.

sources.title: Connecting Relativistic MOND Theories with Mimetic Gravity
sources.supports: Conditional reformulation between constraints; caustic questions and possible movement between scalar/vector formulations explicitly left open.
sources.limits: Does not validate a new regulator or solve nonlinear AeST closure; conditions on timelike fields and branch maps matter.

sources.title: Gravity and large black holes in Randall-Sundrum II braneworlds
sources.supports: Known explicit RSII solutions approach four-dimensional GR at low curvature and have model-specific corrections.
sources.limits: Only abstract-level claim used. Not evidence that observed horizons require five dimensions.

sources.title: Wave-10 Theory & PDE Handoff: 1D/3D Nonlinear AeST Pancake Collapse Test for Dark-WHIM Fluid Closure
sources.inspected: Primary public issue snapshot 2026-11-12 and existing report/model specification
sources.supports: Defines the repository research conjecture and requested collapse test.
sources.limits: Conjecture, not an established result. The GitHub connector was unavailable; browser tool read the public page.

sources.title: Cold sine collapse and coherent wave control
sources.classification: Own reproducible calculation of established equations; regression benchmark, not claimed new physics
sources.supports: A rising pressure proxy, finite stress and a smooth caustic continuation do not establish a thermal closure. Filtered field moments converge to a collisionless reference in this experiment.
sources.limits: No gravity, AeST action, cosmological expansion, nonlinear wave interactions, thermal bath, transverse modes or open-boundary retention.

validation.validation_kind: Exact spectral propagation, exact classical Fourier comparison, independent quadrature, mass/energy/momentum balances, grid refinement, mode occupations and time reversal
validation.initial_numerical_issue: An initial local momentum residual exceeded 1e-9 because differentiating the density FFT three times amplified roundoff. Computing rho_xx from differentiated field products gives the same exact momentum flux and the stated passing residuals. Physical parameters and continuum equations were unchanged.

publication_review_update.status: The original not_done entry about separate-agent review is historical. The second independent review now passes at the stated scope; canonical initial-state mapping and physical dynamics remain incomplete.
